source_gate: Original export/input pins, source SHA receipts, actual payload hashes, readonly canonical single-link files, original full timelines and GT/oracle-off fields verified; rehashed after measurements.
geometry_policy: Same exported vertices for initializer/final within each branch. Proper saved source-mesh-to-aligned SE(3), no prediction changes. Different meshes/scales between branches; cross-branch proxies are not accuracy.
scope: No RGB video re-read, GT, inference, fitting, local video transfer or GPU. Motion proxies do not establish resting-object labels, correct reconstruction, true metric scale, held-out improvement or leaderboard superiority.
integration_note: First CPU audit rejected an incorrect seven-field trajectory schema. Actual native export has eleven fields including pose/scales/shape/expression. Exact schema and shapes corrected; no upstream outputs modified.
decision: Frontend alone has not resolved pose instability. Keep causal baseline; separately qualify occlusion recovery and sequence-level pose estimation before adopting changes. Failed clips remain in the frozen four-clip denominator.
